content: {"argument": "The behavior change is due to a modification in the condition checking whether to keep query parameters. Originally, it checked if the array had a positive length (> 0), meaning an empty array would skip the filtering loop and preserve all parameters. After the refactor, it checks if (length + 1) > 0, which evaluates to true even for an empty array (0 + 1 > 0), causing the loop to run and remove all parameters since none match the empty filter list. This is an unintended regression.", "concedes": true}
